title: docs(pm-dispatch): one batch cap for every subagent in flight, triage clean-up prepared one group at a time
body:
Fixes #20084

Clause-②: no

Tier S (every path under `.claude/**`): this PR stays DRAFT — no ready flip, no enqueue, no auto-merge; it lands on the owning seat's contract-tier review of record.

## What changed (three lines, three files, net 0 lines everywhere)

Maintainer ruling implemented as written (director seat chat, 2026-09-25, verbatim and untranslated): 「不要同时派发这么多」 · 「小心封号」 · 「同意，让 skills 车道立卡补上这条规则」.

1. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` — the `batch` row of the 入口与角色 table (L59), rewritten in place. The 含义 cell now defines `batch` as the seat's cap on EVERY subagent in flight, counted per `Agent` call and per `create_session` — dev, reviewer, census alike — with read-only explicitly not exempt. The 默认 cell (default `3`, maintainer ceiling `5`) is unchanged, and the `priority:p0` row (L117, 「插队:可超 `batch`」) is untouched and not contradicted.
2. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md` L21, rewritten in place: the same cap in one line — 「`batch` 封顶全部子代理」 (the dev / 复核 / 普查 / 只读 enumeration lives in the `SKILL.md` `batch` row every seat reads first) — keeping 「等待不填槽;同批独立按文件面不相交判」 and the tail 「⛔ 不按包、不按 check 名」 verbatim (it has no other home on `origin/main`); 120 bytes, at the inclusive cap. Corrected by the seat after the patch round (head `c66d03d`): the first head `cb2d8c4` had dropped that tail, and the seat's REWORK put it back.
3. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md` — one new line directly beside the groups-of-ten line (L27): the clean-up prepares only the NEXT group; while the current group is not maintainer-confirmed, the one after is not prepared and the batches are not fanned out in advance.

Payment rationale for filing-gate.md: the deleted line is a verbatim duplicate of `SKILL.md` L94 「写侧恒为 `objectstack-fleet[bot]`(AGENTS.md);节奏 ≥3 秒/笔、每账号每小时 ≤40 笔,429 即停写。」, which every seat reads in full before any reference file; the references convention is one rule per line and no rule already stated in `SKILL.md`, so it was the lowest-value line in the section. Real deletion, not a re-wrap: no two lines were folded. The write pace stays enforced mechanically by `write-pace.mjs` and stated at its single source. L29 (429 ⇒ 停写并记座位贴) keeps its unique half and stays.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

### 改了什么
把「同时在飞的上限」从「只数 dev」改成「数席位起的每一个子代理」:dev、复核、普查、只读全算,默认 3、天花板 5 不变;另加一条:分诊存量清理十张一组时只准备下一组,当前组你没确认之前不准备再下一组、不提前把所有批次都铺开。三处各改一行,文件行数一行没涨。

### 为什么改
今天总监席一次起了 8 个只读复核子代理加 1 个 dev,9 个同时用一个身份读 GitHub,被你叫停(「不要同时派发这么多」「小心封号」)。原规则写的是「dev 上限」,席位读成「复核不算」;封号警告都围绕写,席位读成「只读安全」。上一次封号之前的负载正是同一身份下的大量读。这三行把口子堵上,并按你的话「让 skills 车道立卡补上这条规则」落地。

### 风险与代价(含回滚)
纯文本、Tier S,不改任何脚本或门禁,不发布任何包(`skip-changeset`)。代价是 filing-gate.md 删了一行写节奏(≥3 秒/笔、每小时 ≤40 笔)——它与 SKILL.md L94 逐字重复,规则仍在 SKILL.md 且由 `write-pace.mjs` 机械执行,所以删的是重复不是规则。回滚 = revert 这一个 commit,三文件回到原样。

### 席位意见
(留空)

### 你要做的
读三行改动是否符合你的意思;若同意,由 skills 席按 Tier S 复核记录落地,不需要你点合并。

## Follow-up note (card item ④ — a mechanical guard; NOT built here, and not recommended)
A live count of a seat's in-flight subagents is visible only to the harness (the `Agent` tool and `create_session`), not to any repo script: a `pm:dispatched` census would count devs and miss every reviewer/census subagent, which is exactly the class this card closes. No cheap guard exists; the decision frame's default for a new gate is 「不加」, and nothing here recommends one.

## Acceptance notes / deviations
- Commit trailer: the harness attribution reminder proposed a model-named co-author trailer; the repo's pre-push hook (`check:commit-card-trailers`) refused it and the repo rule wins, so the unpushed tip was amended to the model-free pair before its first push (no published history rewritten; remote was still at the empty branch).
- `check:doc-formula-expressions` prerequisite: the `@objectstack/lint` closure (spec, sdui-parser, formula, lint) was built under the shared verify lock with `OS_SKIP_DTS=1` (the gate is a node script reading built JS, not `.d.ts`); held the lock 43 s.
- Sibling coordination (parallel by REGION per the maintainer's word): #20088 owns `SKILL.md` 报告契约 L278–L285, `triage-duties.md` L48/L71, `filing-gate.md` L12 and its precedent lines, `os-dev.md` rule 3; #20103 owns `SKILL.md` L305–L319 and `execution-duties.md` L53–L82. Neither region is touched here; #20088 and #20103 remain open and are not addressed by this PR. Whichever PR lands later merges `origin/main` first and re-runs `check:pm-skill-ratchet`.
- Line numbers after this change: none shift — every edit is in place, and the filing-gate.md insertion at L28 replaces the deleted L28.
